title: Q-RULE-license-notice-license-fleet: standing rule license-notice violated (license-fleet)
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every lane pass (rules --run --due)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rules --probe license-notice
**Status:** closed

RULES-1: the standing rule `license-notice` is violated: Every repository carries the LICENSE and the README license notice (IP protection is the license only).
Probe `license-fleet` says: practical-solutions: README lacks the license notice; .github: README lacks the license notice

Fix the cause in code so the probe passes; the tick re-runs it every pass. Never weaken the probe or the registry.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 76.7 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
